about.description: Paragon is a HIP-3 builder-deployed perpetual venue on Hyperliquid built by N8V Labs and founded by Taha El-Magbri, focused on crypto-native market-index perpetuals. Launched April 2, 2026, it became the first venue to list cash-settled perpetual contracts on widely tracked analytical benchmarks — BTC.D (Bitcoin's share of total crypto market cap), TOTAL2 (total crypto market cap excluding Bitcoin), and OTHERS (altcoin market cap excluding the top 10) — with up to 50× leverage. Markets appear under the para namespace on Hyperliquid and are margined and cash-settled in USDC.
about.registryInfo: Paragon is built by N8V Labs and led by Founder Taha El-Magbri. Markets are deployed under the para namespace on Hyperliquid via HIP-3 builder-deployed perpetuals. Paragon launched the first crypto-native perpetual index markets (BTC.D, TOTAL2, OTHERS) on April 2, 2026.

fees.revenueNotes: Paragon is a HIP-3 builder-deployer on Hyperliquid. Fees follow HIP-3 framework: standard taker ~7-9 bps, Growth Mode taker ~0.45-0.9 bps. 50% of fees go to Paragon deployer, 50% to Hyperliquid protocol. Source: https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hyperliquid-improvement-proposals-hips/hip-3-builder-deployed-perpetuals
